pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition on adding to positions unless the primary order has achieved at least +$3.00 floating profit and breaks the local 15-minute high/low.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a 3-bar volume confirmation and a 5-period EMA slope alignment before market entry to filter out low-conviction consolidation noise.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively trail stops using a 3-candle low/high structural offset once floating profit exceeds +$4.00 to protect gains from rapid evaporation.
